criteria.criterion: Exactly one package calls exec.Command or exec.CommandContext with "git"; no other non-test Go file under internal/ or cmd/ does (internal/cli, internal/defect, internal/driver, internal/intervention, internal/metrics and internal/runs all go through it).
criteria.evidence: grep of exec.Command in non-test files under internal/ and cmd/ shows git only at internal/gitrun/gitrun.go:15; the other hits run claude, gate scripts and keepawake.

criteria.criterion: The driver's hardening — -c core.hooksPath=<the recreated empty hooks dir>, -c core.fsmonitor=false, -c core.quotepath=false — applies to exactly the commands gitCmd builds today and to no other; gitPath's `rev-parse --git-path` and configEntries' `git config --file <path> --no-includes --list -z` stay plain. A hardening flag added to or dropped from any call is a violation.
criteria.evidence: internal/driver/gitguard.go: gitCmd calls gitrun.Hardened with the same flags and the same recreate-empty hooks dir; gitPath uses gitrun.At and configEntries uses gitrun.Plain; all other callers use At or Capture, with no -c flags.

criteria.criterion: Each caller keeps its trimming and its error text exactly: runGit's `git <subcommand>: <stderr>` and `git <subcommand>: <err>`, blame's `git <args>: <err>: <stderr>`, the callers that return raw bytes, TrimSpace or TrimRight of newlines, and those that only test the exit status.
criteria.evidence: The diff leaves runGit, gitOut in doctor/intervention and the exit-status callers untouched except for the command constructor. Capture reproduces the old `git %s: %w: %s` text byte for byte in defect/blame.go, metrics/lines.go and runs/commits.go.

criteria.criterion: No command's output, exit code, files written or session arguments change, and no earlier test changes (H1-H7: the unchanged tests are the behaviour check).
criteria.evidence: The diff touches only non-test files plus the new gitrun package; the arguments are identical (-C root prefix); the go check log is green.

criteria.criterion: The runner package carries unit tests of its own for what it centralises (at least: the hardened form's arguments and the plain form's absence of them, and an error's text), run by the checks.
criteria.evidence: internal/gitrun/gitrun_test.go: TestHardenedCarriesTheOverrides, TestPlainFormsCarryNoOverrides, TestCaptureErrorText, TestCaptureReturnsStdoutUntrimmed; go.log shows ok for internal/gitrun.
